meta._about: Object index -> classification. Index == position in SCENE.objects == node index in the embedded GLB.

roles.shell: walls, foundation, floors, ceilings, baseboards: keep geometry exactly (plank/grain strips may be replaced by a textured slab, keep=texture)
roles.opening: windows, glass, doors, casings, skylight shaft/frame, door hardware: keep exactly (hardware may be restyled)
roles.fixture: kitchen cabinets/island/appliances, vanities, WCs, tub, showers, built-in wardrobes, fireplace, light fixtures, mirrors: keep footprint/position; restyle allowed
roles.decor: rugs, bedding, art, plants, accessories, curtains, lamps: replaceable
roles.exterior: roof planes, ridge caps, flashing, fascia, stucco skin, gables: keep exactly (garage door face panels restyle)

keep_values.footprint: preserve position and outer dimensions; materials/details may change
keep_values.texture: may be collapsed into a texture on the floor slab
